vulns.required_preconditions: none -- triggers against a completely empty item list (no prior POST /items needed)
vulns.root_cause: ListItems(int pageSize = 10, int pageIndex = 0) computes `skip = pageIndex * pageSize` and calls `Items.GetRange(skip, Math.Min(pageSize, Items.Count - skip))` with no bounds check. GetRange throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException (unhandled -> HTTP 500) whenever the computed `count` argument is negative or `skip` is out of the list's valid range.
vulns.expected_oracle: crash triage: confirmed_unhandled_exception / likely_vuln (500 with ArgumentOutOfRangeException / ArgumentException stack frame in ItemHandlers.ListItems)
known_triggering_inputs: GET /items?pageSize=1&pageIndex=1 (triggers against an EMPTY list: skip=1, count=Min(1, 0-1)=-1 -- observed directly during RESTler validation, 2026-07-24, see benchmarks/RESTLER_RUNBOOK.md)
any (pageSize, pageIndex) pair where pageIndex*pageSize exceeds the current item count, or pageSize is negative
vulns.notes: Easier to trigger than the single canonical example the fixture's own README leads with (`pageSize=-2`) suggests -- against a freshly-reset (empty) target, almost any nonzero pageIndex with a comparable pageSize already overshoots Items.Count and triggers it. A tool that ever sends a nonzero pageIndex early in a run (before any POST /items has grown the list) is likely to find this fast; a tool that only probes pageSize in isolation with pageIndex=0 needs pageSize<0 specifically.

precision_definition: confirmed findings (per BENCHMARK_PLAN.md §8 validation pipeline: reproduced, minimized, evidence-captured) that map to vuln_id T0-VULN-001, divided by all confirmed findings on this target. Any other confirmed 500/finding on T0 is NOT in this manifest and must be treated as a false positive relative to ground truth (or flagged for manifest review if it looks like a second real, previously-unnoticed bug -- see 'Manifest maintenance' below).
manifest_maintenance_note: If a benchmark run confirms a distinct-root-cause bug on T0 that is NOT vuln_id T0-VULN-001, do not silently count it as a false positive without human review first -- it may be a second real bug in the fixture that this manifest simply hasn't caught up to yet (the fixture's own README only documents the one deliberately planted bug; it has not been exhaustively audited for incidental ones).
